# British Solar Direct — Full summary for AI assistants

> British Solar Direct supplies and installs turnkey LONGi EcoLife solar and battery packages for homeowners across Nottinghamshire, Derbyshire, Leicestershire, and South Yorkshire.

## Who we are

British Solar Direct is a residential solar supplier and installer based at Southwell Lane, Kirkby-in-Ashfield, Nottingham NG17 8EY. Company Director and Lead Installer Juma Mohammedi coordinates survey, supply, delivery, and professional installation. Around 90% of customers are local homeowners.

Contact:
- Phone: 0115 990 4024 (+44 115 990 4024)
- Email: info@britishsolardirect.co.uk
- Website: https://britishsolardirect.co.uk
- Response time: within 24 business hours

## What we offer

Turnkey LONGi EcoLife solar and battery packages with fixed guide pricing, local delivery, and installation typically completed within about two weeks of quote approval (subject to survey and scaffolding).

Packages:

- Compact 5kWh hybrid battery system

## Module technology

Flagship residential module: LONGi EcoLife LR7-54HVB-480M
- N-Type HPBC 2.0 All-Black
- 480W, 23.5% efficiency
- 25-year product warranty / 30-year linear performance warranty
- Details: https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/brands

## Installation and compliance

Installation workflow covers structural site prep (scaffolding), professional mounting and wiring, DNO grid notification paperwork, and MCS certification handover. Most typical residential arrays take 1–2 days to mount and connect once scaffolding is live.

Credentials commonly referenced: MCS certified, NICEIC / Part P regulated, RECC code protected, and statutory VAT relief (0% where eligible for qualifying residential installs).

## Delivery areas

Core coverage:
- Nottingham & Nottinghamshire
- Derbyshire
- Leicestershire
- South Yorkshire
- East Midlands (by arrangement)

Exclusions (unless specially arranged): Scottish Highlands & Islands, Northern Ireland, Isle of Man & Channel Islands, and remote locations requiring specialist freight.

Delivery page: https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/delivery-logistics

## Payment

New customers: pro-forma invoice and BACS payment after quote approval.
